Suite numbers (705, 710, 725), the 'daytime' occupancy, and 'wet' sprinklers are not in the building data. Remove them or mark them unverified, because the crew could act on invented details.

You gave elevator counts and stories, which was the right priority. But you never asked for the building engineer or property manager to bring keys, and the tenant, construction and sprinkler detail adds noise.
